Game Overview

Webby is a platformer game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Webby comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Webby?

Webby is a free platformer game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Webby free to play?

Yes, Webby is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
